body:
DESIGN, N-34 (helper-n34, 15 Nov 2026). Docs only, no code. START HERE. Full text: docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md, section "N-34" under P2-04 (design PR). Parts 2 to 5 of this thread: the rule, the repair, tests and what is not proven, the questions for the advisor.

CAUSE, read in the code: (1) an import carries an album only when YouTube Music lists one (imports/readers.py:289-296); an upload, a video or a yt-dlp entry has none. (2) the keeper files it under Encore/<artist>/Singles (placement.py:86) with no album tag (keeper.py:183-194). (3) the music server groups by TAGS: no tag = its [Unknown Album] bucket per artist. (4) the phone's artist page draws the music server's getAlbumList2 (sync_engine.dart:520, detail_screens.dart:716). Nothing asks the catalogue: the keeper never does for an imported song (keeper.py:181: ref.get("coverUrl") is already YouTube's thumbnail when there is a video id, refs.py:134), and the cover finder stores a picture, never an id or album (cover_finder.py:177-191) and selects only refs without a cover (:104). Filling ref.album alone changes the song's line, NOT the artist page: the files must be retagged, filed and linked again.

THE DESIGN IN TEN LINES
1. New module album_finder.py (not identity.py): pure matcher + a pass as an errand BEFORE the cover finder. ~1 search per song + ~2 requests per distinct album at the gate's 4 a second = about 5 to 8 minutes of gate time for the ~650 songs, once.
2. Catalogue._lead hard-codes priority="interactive" (catalogue.py:586): slice 1 threads a priority argument; the pass uses background.
3. Match = same artist, title AND version_signature, length within 3 s (UNMEASURED: the dry run freezes it), earliest release among album/ep (single only when nothing else), album artist = song artist; deezer_id/isrc stamped only when free; a taken id or a same-album twin = HELD pair, nothing filled.
4. Own columns identity_tried_at / identity_rev / identity_outcome (matched, none, held); an outage is never stored (B-124).
5. New keeps: identity at the top of _finish with the file's own length, short wait, keep as before when the catalogue cannot be asked; the B-110 reuse fix is part of the slice.
6. Repair = refile.py, ONE machinery for N-34 and N-26 slice 5, as a linker errand (same thread as the library scan, so CF-42's race cannot open), per file: copy+retag+move, one scan per batch, find by size, swap the SAME song_file row, delete the old file one pass later; journal table; DB copy first; undo.
7. N-34 DEPENDS ON P2-25 (advisor ruling): the repair hard-needs it (items.json needs P2-25 [d]; order.json now has P2-25 just before N-34), every earlier slice skips names that do not survive the fold WHOLE, test row 'two different Arabic songs, ONE Deezer hit: neither gets an album'.
8. Creature's twin: HELD, never put into the other ref's folder; the end is a merge by identity (slice 6, decision 1).
9. Slices: 1 matcher+dry run, 2 facts+pass, 3 new keeps, 4 proof against Navidrome 0.64.2, 5 repair (needs P2-25), 6 pair merge, 7 doors.
10. Audit B-133 (cover finder accepts a live version and any name that folds to nothing; keeper never asks), B-110 closed by slice 3; RELEASE-CANDIDATE 4b gate: slices 1 to 3 in the first public image.
Nothing is built, marked or walked.
